description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Array, which represents an array value in the context of XML-RPC, extending functionality from Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Collection. It includes methods for constructing an array value and generating its XML representation.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Array
classes.description: Represents an array type in XML-RPC, capable of initializing its value and generating XML output.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with an array value and sets its type to array.

methods.name: _generateXml
methods.description: Generates the XML representation of the array value for XML-RPC.
